description:
Cast Etali by paying {5}{R}{R}.
When Etali enters, it triggers, exiling cards from each player's library until a nonland card is exiled, and allowing you to cast any number of those cards for free. Ensure to cast at least two spells.
Rocco triggers for each spell cast. Target Etali with one trigger, and any other creatures as applicable.
Monk Gyatso triggers, airbending Etali.
The Rocco trigger targeting Etali fizzles as it has no legal targets.
Resolve all other Rocco triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the chosen creature(s) and creating that many Food tokens.
Activate up to two Foods by tapping them, adding {G} for each Food tapped.
Cast Etali from exile by paying {2}.
Rocco triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature and creating a Food token.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.name: Etali, Primal Conqueror // Etali, Primal Sickness
